Privacy Support

LifeOS (BrendanOS) Privacy Policy

Last updated: July 2026

This Privacy Policy describes how Everlight Digital ("we", "us") collects, uses, and shares information when you use LifeOS, a personal life-management web app also known internally as BrendanOS.

Information We Collect

  • Account: your email address, display name, timezone, and (for non-owner accounts) a hashed password. Sign-in uses a 6-digit email code.
  • Your content: notes, tasks, journal entries, decisions, habit logs, self-logged mood, and meals/nutrition you enter — by web, or via our Telegram bot. We do not ingest Apple Health, wearable, or device-sensor data.
  • Usage: lightweight per-day counts of AI requests, to manage cost.
  • Social posting (if you connect X or Threads): the post text you draft and the resulting post ID, so we can show you it published successfully.

How We Use It

  • To run the app's features (capture, recall, journal, habits, scheduled social posts).
  • AI processing: your captured text is sent to Anthropic (Claude) to classify it and answer your questions, and to Voyage AI to create the semantic-search embeddings that power recall. These providers process your text to return a result; we do not use your data to train models.

We do not sell your data. We do not run third-party advertising trackers.

Third Parties (Processors)

  • Anthropic (Claude) — AI classification + question answering
  • Voyage AI — text embeddings for semantic search
  • Railway — hosting + database
  • Resend — sends your sign-in code email
  • Telegram — if you use the capture bot, messages you send it pass through Telegram
  • X (Twitter) and Meta (Threads) — if you connect and schedule posts, your drafted text is sent to that platform's API to publish on your behalf
  • Crossway (ESV) — Scripture text is shown under a non-commercial license

Data Retention

You can delete your account at any time by emailing us; we erase your data from our database, including your search embeddings, within 30 days. Backups are automatic and may retain a deleted account for a short rolling window before rotating out.

Your Rights

Depending on where you live (e.g. GDPR, CCPA), you can request access to, correction of, a copy of, or deletion of your personal data. Contact brendan@everlight-digital.com to exercise them.

Security

Data is encrypted in transit (TLS). Sessions use an HMAC-signed cookie. AI provider API keys are never shipped to the client — all AI requests are routed through our server.

Changes to This Policy

We may update this policy. Material changes will be reflected here with an updated date.
